meanings.en: to appear, to show up, to turn up
meanings.note: Prefix 'по-' forms perfective verbs or marks a brief/onset action (stem 'явиться'). Reflexive/intransitive verb with the postfix '-ся'/'-сь' (historically from the reflexive pronoun 'себя', oneself). Used as an perfective (single completed action) verb meaning 'shows up, appears', paired with 'появляться'.
